text:
marta: Quick follow-up on the rollout metadata RFC -- I'm proposing a small 'selector' expression primitive so we can target model versions with logic while keeping manifests indexable.

marta: Tiny example:

```json
"selector": "env == 'prod' && (region in ['us-east','us-west'] || perf_tier >= 3)"
```

marta: Goals: compact storage, safe evaluation, first-class backward compatibility for older clients.

tom: Agreed on safety: grammar must be minimal. Allow literals (strings, numbers), enum fields, comparisons, IN, && || !, and parentheses. No functions, no regex, no JSONPath.

kevin: Perf note: compile to a small opcode/token stream and cache compiled forms keyed by manifest hash. That lets us evaluate in ~tens of microseconds per request.

kevin: For storage, don't keep raw strings in hot path. Keep a compact token array in the resolver cache; manifests can reference the compiled blob by id.

marta: Backcompat options: server-side materializer that expands selectors into an explicit tag set (compat_tags) per model/version, and include that in the manifest. Clients that don't understand selectors use compat_tags. Thoughts?

barry: That seems safest. Also allows DB-level short-circuiting: index on compat_tags + perf_tier ranges so most requests avoid expression eval.

schema-bot: PR #4982 manifest-lint: missing schema doc for field 'compat_tags' -- add type = array[string] and note it's generated for compatibility.

marta: Telemetry: resolver should emit a short match_code (e.g. "sel:region", "sel:perf_tier") indicating which clause matched; sample full evaluation traces at 0.5% to audit drift.

tom: UX: expose a visual rule builder in the console by default and an "advanced" text editor for power users. Show lint errors inline and a preview of the materialized compat_tags.

kevin: Security: forbid any operators that could imply code execution. Set a strict evaluation time budget (e.g., 50us); on timeout fail closed to compat_tags and emit a sampled alert.

barry: For canaries we should bump sampling for evaluation traces and error logs so debugging is easier without spamming SRE pages.

marta: Proposed action items:
1) Draft a minimal EBNF grammar and allowed field list.
2) Prototype a server-side materializer that outputs compat_tags and a small compatibility flag.
3) Implement tokenized serialization prototype + an embeddable resolver library for Dedicated/Private.
4) Console UX mock: visual builder + advanced mode + inline lint.

marta: I'll file a tracking ticket INF-3010 and sketch the grammar tomorrow. Any objections to shipping compat_tags by default?

tom: +1

kevin: +1

marta: Cool. Thanks all, will post the RFC update with the grammar and a rough op-code layout. :white_check_mark:
